description.value: The Kamloops Museum and Archives is a free, publicly operated institution in downtown Kamloops dedicated to preserving the history and heritage of the region and the Secwépemc people. It houses permanent and rotating exhibitions, a Children's Museum, archival collections, and educational programs for all ages. As a no-fee attraction operated by the City of Kamloops, it is an accessible cultural stop for touring cyclists passing through the downtown core.
